Sapa · Lào Cai · Northern Vietnam

The mountains of Sapa, shown to you by someone who lives here.

Small-group motorbike rides and village treks through the Muong Hoa valley — rice terraces, waterfalls, hill-tribe villages, and the O Quy Ho pass at sunset.

See the tours Message the guide

Your guide

Off the main road, at your pace.

I'm Tàng, a local guide based in Sapa town. I take travellers into the valleys where the Black H'mong, Giáy and Red Dao communities live — by motorbike or on foot, in a small group or just the two of us.

Every tour below is run by me, with drivers I ride with and families whose homes I know. You'll see terraced fields, working villages and quiet trails most visitors never reach.

— Tàng, Sapa

Signature ride

Private motorbike day tour through the valley & up to the pass.

$60 / person
~8 hours Local driver-guide Lunch included Villages · waterfalls · O Quy Ho
09:30

Hotel pick-up & briefing

Pick-up at your hotel in Sapa town, a short safety briefing and helmet fitting before we set off.

09:40

Along the Hoang Lien Son range

Ride the mountain road with the cool breeze and wide valley views. After about 2 km we stop at Y Linh Ho — a quiet village of ethnic minority families — for photos by the river and terraced fields.

10:00

Lao Chai village

One of the oldest villages in the valley and home to a large Black H'mong community. Traditional wooden houses, hemp weaving and everyday mountain life.

11:00

Ta Van village

Where Giáy and Red Dao families live side by side. Cross the rattan bridge and look out over the rice terraces.

12:15

Lunch in Sapa

Ride back to town for a local lunch and a short rest to recharge.

13:45

Silver Waterfall

Toward the O Quy Ho pass. Climb the steps beside a waterfall dropping more than 200 m and feel the spray off the white water.

14:45

Love Waterfall

A gentle 20-minute walk through bamboo forest along a golden stream to a 100 m waterfall hidden in the trees.

16:00

Heaven's Gate — O Quy Ho pass

Nearly 2,000 m up: the winding pass below and the sun setting behind the mountains. The high point of the day.

17:15

Back to your hotel

Down the pass and back into Sapa. Tour ends at your hotel.

Included

  • Motorbike, helmets and a local driver-guide
  • Local lunch
  • Entrance tickets for the villages, Silver Waterfall and Love Waterfall

Good to know

  • The Heaven's Gate entrance ticket is not included

On foot

One-day village treks

Six routes through the Muong Hoa valley and the hills around Sapa. Prices are per person; join a small group or go private.

Classic
Y Linh Ho → Lao Chai → Ta Van

Set off on foot from your hotel at 9:30. Walk the main road, then drop into Y Linh Ho (Black H'mong). Continue about 4 km to Lao Chai for a picnic lunch by the river, then on to Ta Van (Giáy). Return to Sapa by car.

$20Group
$32Private
Full day · ~10 km
Terraces & forest
Lao Chai → Ta Van → Giang Ta Chai

Pick-up at 9:30 and a short drive (~6 km) to Lao Chai. Trek through the rice terraces to Ta Van, with lunch at a Giáy homestay or local restaurant, then through bamboo forest to Giang Ta Chai (Red Dao). Stop at the small waterfall and rattan suspension bridge. Return by car.

$28Group
$35Private
Full day
Private
Suoi Ho → Ma Tra → Ta Phin

From your hotel at 9:30, trek along buffalo trails to Ma Tra (Black H'mong): rice paddies, corn and artichoke fields, a local school. Continue through the terraces to Ta Phin (Black H'mong and Red Dao). Lunch at a restaurant or homestay, then Ta Phin cave — and, if you like, a Red Dao herbal bath. Return by car.

$29Private
Full day
Family · cooking
Saseng → Hang Da → Hau Thao

A quieter, family-focused day. From around 9:00, drive and hike up to about 1,800 m to Saseng and Hang Da (Black H'mong): remote villages, fruit orchards, and the full panorama of the valley from Hau Thao. Shop at the market, then cook and share a home-made meal with a local family. Return by car.

$30Private
Full day · a meal at home
By car · no guide needed
Silver Waterfall → Golden Stream → Love Waterfall → Heaven's Gate

A relaxed day by car with a driver — no guide required. A 30-minute drive to Silver Waterfall, then the golden stream and Love Waterfall, and up to Heaven's Gate on the Tram Ton pass before returning to Sapa. Bring friends to share the car; entrance tickets are bought on site.

$55Car + driver
Full day · flexible
Short & easy
Cat Cat → Sinh Chai

Walk down into the valley toward Cat Cat (~4 km), past an early-1900s French hydro-power station. See village life in the paddy fields, then hike on to Sinh Chai at the foot of Fansipan before returning to Sapa.

$24Per person
Half to full day
Sundays only

Bac Ha Sunday market

One of the most colourful markets in the north — and it happens just once a week. Set off at 7:30 and spend the morning among the Flower H'mong, Black Zao, Phu La and Tay peoples in their finest dress. Wander the livestock and textile rows, then the food stalls where families meet over a bowl and a cup of corn wine. Lunch in town, then the 100-year-old village of Ban Pho, with a stop at the Vietnam–China border at Lao Cai on the way back to Sapa.

$26 / person · group tour

Overnight

Two-day Muong Hoa valley trek

Y Linh Ho · Lao Chai · Ta Van · Giang Ta Chai — with a night in a family home in the valley.

Day 1 · ~12 km

Three villages, dinner with a family

Set off at 9:30 and trek through three villages of the Black H'mong and Giáy. Lunch on the trail, dinner with a local family, and a night in a traditional Giáy house in Ta Van.

Day 2

Bamboo forest to Giang Ta Chai

After breakfast, trek through bamboo forest to Giang Ta Chai. Lunch near the waterfall and rattan bridge, explore the village, then return to Sapa.

$85 / person · includes homestay
